name: Dakkan Kikou Luvnatier
original_name: 奪還機構 ラヴネイティア
source:
Main character is a master of the coffee shop. But his true occupation is the leader of combat maid unit using nano-technology to transform and defeat evil. Two waitresses and childhood friend make the rest of the team.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公表面上是一家咖啡馆的店主，真实身份却是一支战斗女仆小队的队长。小队成员能够利用纳米技术变身，击败世上的邪恶势力。店里的两名女服务生以及主人公的青梅竹马，便是这支小队的其余成员。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
